summary_one_liner: V4 dispatch (Option E: cluster_config.yaml run_finemap.threads=2) completed cleanly at 12:45:51 EDT (wall 2h 25m, far under the 10-15 hr CONSERVATIVE_BOTH envelope). 105/105 snakemake steps DONE; 96/96 run_finemap fits landed with all mtimes > V4 dispatch ts (10:20:40 EDT); 0 errors, 0 bsub rejections; all 3 pinned SH2B3 .fit.rds md5s changed from pre-rebuild values (niter=100 -> niter=1000 rebuild empirically confirmed). HOWEVER: live results/qtl_coloc/ contains only 6 aggregator TSVs and ZERO per-region JSONs. Root cause: snakemake's `aggregate_qtl_coloc` rule enumerates per-region wildcards via a glob over results/qtl_coloc/*.json AT DAG PLANNING TIME (one-shot, not re-evaluated mid-run); after V4 driver mv'd live qtl_coloc/ to .preFix.bak.20260430_102053/ pre-dispatch, the planning-time glob returned 0 matches, so the DAG planned 0 run_qtl_coloc instances. --forcerun run_qtl_coloc was a NO-OP because snakemake forces only what's in the reachable DAG, and run_qtl_coloc was unreachable (input pattern not enumerated). The PASS gate's literal text is satisfied (too_few_snps count = 0 <= 200 vacuously; 96/96 .fit.rds mtimes > V4 ts), but the gate's INTENT (CONSERVATIVE_BOTH = rebuild BOTH SuSiE-RSS layer AND qtl_coloc layer at honest niter=1000) is partially satisfied: SuSiE-RSS layer = REBUILT; qtl_coloc layer = NOT REBUILT. Per feedback_rigor_over_speed.md: classified as PARTIAL_PASSED rather than vacuous PASS to surface the gap honestly. Wave 4.5 follow-up needed to rebuild qtl_coloc layer with the now-existing .fit.rds files as inputs (option: re-fire driver as a 2nd snakemake invocation; the new DAG-planning-time glob will now enumerate the 96 .fit.rds files and plan run_qtl_coloc per-region jobs). PID 830751 (other-terminal results_identity_ld) preserved untouched throughout.

Pre-V4 baseline had 1274 per-region JSONs (preserved in .preFix.bak.20260430_081210/).
qtl_coloc_layer_gap_diagnosis.root_cause: Snakefile's aggregate_qtl_coloc rule (per V2 tracker root_cause_analysis): inputs come from a dynamic glob over results/qtl_coloc/*.json. snakemake DAG planning is one-shot at startup: it enumerates wildcards from whatever globs match at planning time. V4 driver mv'd live qtl_coloc/ to .preFix.bak.20260430_102053/ before snakemake DAG planning fired -> planning-time glob returned 0 matches -> 0 run_qtl_coloc instances in the DAG -> --forcerun run_qtl_coloc was a no-op (snakemake forces only what's reachable in the planned DAG).
qtl_coloc_layer_gap_diagnosis.why_v1_abort_dispatch_did_fan_out: V1 (commit 2891d5e abort) fired before V2's snakemake --touch and before any pre-fire mv: at that moment, results/qtl_coloc/ contained 1,274 STALE JSONs from the prior production run (niter=100 buggy code). The script-newer-than-outputs cascade trigger fired because run_susie_rss.R (newest from commit 02c4404) was newer than .fit.rds outputs, forcing 96 run_finemap fan-out + the per-region run_qtl_coloc cascade that consumed those 1,274 stale JSONs as input wildcards. V1 was killed mid-flight before it could complete the rebuild.
qtl_coloc_layer_gap_diagnosis.design_limitation_observed: The driver's mv-then-rebuild pattern fundamentally cannot rebuild the qtl_coloc layer in a single snakemake invocation because the per-region wildcards aren't enumerable from an empty live dir. The ONLY way to rebuild qtl_coloc-layer per-region in this Snakefile is to either (a) run snakemake twice (1st: fit run_finemap; 2nd: glob the .fit.rds outputs and plan run_qtl_coloc), or (b) refactor the Snakefile to enumerate run_qtl_coloc wildcards from a manifest TSV instead of a dynamic glob. V1+V2+V3+V4 all hit this limit in different ways.
